title: Outsider Art Inspiration
slide_intent: Make deliberate irregularity legible as a choice so illustration can convey individuality rather than accidental inconsistency.
strategic_value: Uneven strokes and impossible proportions can give Mailchimp an approachable, unconventional character.
demonstration: Orange annotations identify intuitive composition, unrefined linework and surreal proportions around a large figure inspecting small plants and figures.
practical_value: Use the annotated specimen to distinguish expressive irregularity from a uniform geometric style.

content_islands.name: Illustration
content_islands.spec: Center the oversized hand and magnifying glass beside the small plant figures.

content_islands.name: Annotations
content_islands.spec: Surround the drawing with orange labels, a bracket, circles and arrows tied to specific features.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Outsider Art Inspiration text connects imperfect hand drawing to Mailchimp’s outsider identity.
reference_purposes.Expression: Annotations identify the drawing’s uneven line and surreal scale.
reference_purposes.Application: The labels point to concrete features another illustrator can examine.

ingredient.name: Illustration irregularity
ingredient.role: Give the drawing a visibly human and unconventional character.
ingredient.application: Vary stroke texture and relative scale as the annotated specimen demonstrates.
ingredient.scope: Qualitative case-study direction; no numeric construction rule.
